authorization_source: User instruction 'tiến hành bước kế tiếp' after the frozen Wayback language V2 error analysis was verified.
research_question: Can a single standard English stop-word filtering step reduce direct-address and function-word style shortcuts without degrading cross-source label discrimination?

observations: Generic direct-address and navigation terms including your, our and you repeatedly pushed legitimate pages toward label 1.
Function words including in, for and about repeatedly pushed some confirmed pages toward label 0.
The frozen external benchmark is used only to formulate this hypothesis and is prohibited from V3 scoring or selection.
hypothesis_origin.interpretation_limit: The observation motivates one standard representation change; it does not authorize a hand-tuned token list or reuse of the opened external benchmark.

development_design.method: deterministic four-fold grouped out-of-fold evaluation within the original train partition
development_design.assignment: Within each source_dataset and source label stratum, sort complete split_group_id values by SHA-256(seed|group_id), then assign round-robin to folds. A group is never split.
development_design.confirmation_rule: After all development out-of-fold predictions exist, fit both frozen representations on all train rows and score the existing validation partition once.

single_challenger.stop_words: scikit-learn ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS frozen by the installed scikit-learn runtime

selection_policy.if_any_gate_fails: Retain ISI_TEXT_BASELINE_V2. Do not open internal test, do not create a challenger model artifact and do not score any existing external benchmark.
selection_policy.if_all_gates_pass: Freeze the validation-only research candidate. Internal test remains closed; external evaluation requires a newly collected untouched benchmark and a separate owner gate.

prohibited_interpretations: Do not treat removal of a stop word as evidence that the word is unrelated to deception in every context.
Do not claim the candidate generalizes externally from internal development or validation results.
Do not rescore the opened Wayback language V2 benchmark with this candidate.
Do not describe the Mendeley label as regulator-verified investment fraud.
